rows.ja: 供給元(装置・材料・後工程)
合弁・出資・関連会社

relations.text: 1997年から戦略的提携。TSMCがASEを非独占の優先提供先に指定
relations.text_en: Strategic alliance since 1997; TSMC designates ASE as a non-exclusive preferred provider

source.label: ASE Technology Holding Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: TSMC designates us as its non-exclusive preferred provider of packaging and testing services for semiconductors manufactured by TSMC.

relations.text: Entegrisの売上の16%をTSMCが占める
relations.text_en: TSMC accounted for 16% of Entegris’ net sales in 2025

source.label: Entegris Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Percentage of net sales to top customers: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) 16% 16% 11%

relations.text: KLAの売上の10%超をTSMCが占める
relations.text_en: TSMC accounted for over 10% of KLA’s revenues in fiscal 2024-2026

source.label: KLA Form 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: the following customers each accounted for more than 10% of total revenues, primarily in the Semiconductor Process Control segment: Year Ended June 30, 2026 2025 2024 Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited

relations.text: Lamが年次報告で、最も重要な顧客の1社としてTSMCを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lam’s annual report names TSMC among its most significant customers

source.label: Lam Research Form 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our most significant customers during the fiscal years ending June 28, 2026, June 29, 2025, and June 30, 2024 included Micron Technology, Inc., Samsung Electronics Company, Ltd., SK hynix Inc., and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company.

relations.text: Ontoが年次報告で、売上の大きな部分を台湾のファウンドリ(TSMCなど)への販売から得ていると記載
relations.text_en: Onto’s annual report says it derives substantial revenue from sales to foundries in Taiwan such as TSMC

source.label: Onto Innovation Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we derive substantial revenue from sales to semiconductor device foundries in Taiwan such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd.

relations.text: NVIDIAが年次報告で、ウエハーの製造をTSMCなどのファウンドリに委託していると記載
relations.text_en: NVIDIA’s annual report says it uses foundries such as TSMC to produce its wafers

source.label: NVIDIA Form 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We utilize foundries, such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, or TSMC, and Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., or Samsung, to produce our semiconductor wafers.

relations.text: AMDが年次報告で、7nm以下のウエハーは全てTSMCに依存と記載
relations.text_en: AMD’s annual report says it relies on TSMC for all wafers at 7nm or smaller nodes

source.label: AMD Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We rely on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) for the production of all wafers for microprocessor and GPU products at 7 nanometer (nm) or smaller nodes

relations.text: Broadcomが年次報告で、前工程の製造の大半をTSMCなどに委託していると記載
relations.text_en: Broadcom’s annual report says it outsources most front-end wafer manufacturing to foundries including TSMC

source.label: Broadcom Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During fiscal year 2025, approximately 95% of the wafers manufactured by our CMs were produced by TSMC.

relations.text: Qualcommが年次報告で、主なファウンドリの供給元としてTSMCを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm’s annual report names TSMC among its primary foundry suppliers

source.label: Qualcomm Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The primary foundry suppliers for our various digital, analog/mixed-signal, RF and PM integrated circuits include Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Samsung Electronics and Global Foundries.

relations.text: Astera Labsが年次報告で、全てのICの製造をTSMCに委託(唯一の製造パートナー)と記載
relations.text_en: Astera Labs’ annual report says TSMC is its sole manufacturing partner for ICs

source.label: Astera Labs Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use a fabless manufacturing model and partner with TSMC to fabricate all of our ICs.

relations.text: Credoが年次報告で、2026年度はウエハー製造にTSMCだけを使ったと記載
relations.text_en: Credo’s annual report says it exclusively used TSMC for wafer production in fiscal 2026

source.label: Credo Technology Form 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In fiscal year 2026, we exclusively used Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC) for semiconductor wafer production.

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、一部の製品でTSMCの生産能力を使っていると記載
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report says it uses TSMC foundry capacity for some tiles or products

source.label: Intel Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We expect to continue to use TSMC and other third-party foundry suppliers for various key tiles in a number of current and future products.

relations.text: Intelが年次報告で、先端プロセス技術の主な競合としてTSMCを挙げている
relations.text_en: Intel’s annual report names TSMC as its primary competitor in leading-edge process technology

source.label: Intel Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitor in leading-edge semiconductor process technology is TSMC, which holds a leading position in manufacturing at scale for the most advanced nodes.

relations.text: 熊本のJASMにソニーセミコンダクタソリューションズが20%未満を出資
relations.text_en: Sony Semiconductor Solutions took a less than 20% stake in JASM (Kumamoto) in January 2022

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In January 2022, Sony Semiconductor Solution Corporation ("Sony") acquired a less than 20% equity interest in JASM.

relations.text: ソニーセミコンダクタソリューションズとTSMCが戦略的提携を探る拘束力のない覚書(MOU)を締結
relations.text_en: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC signed a non-binding MOU to pursue a strategic partnership

source.label: Sony Group 20-F(2026年3月期)
source.quote: entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding to pursue a strategic partnership for the development and manufacturing of next-generation image sensors
source.note: 拘束力のない覚書の段階です。

relations.text: 熊本のJASMにDENSOが10%超を出資
relations.text_en: DENSO took a more than 10% stake in JASM

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In April 2022, DENSO Corporation ("DENSO") acquired a more than 10% minority equity interest in JASM.

relations.text: JASMの第2工場への追加投資が発表され、Toyotaも少数株主として出資
relations.text_en: Further investment in JASM’s second fab announced; Toyota also took a minority stake

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: also took a minority stake in JASM.

relations.text: ドイツ・ドレスデンのESMCに10%を出資
relations.text_en: Took a 10% stake in ESMC in Dresden, Germany

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: In January 2024, Robert Bosch GmbH, Infineon Technologies AG, and NXP Semiconductors Germany GmbH, a wholly-owned subsidiary of NXP Semiconductors N.V. ("NXP"), each acquired 10% equity interest

relations.text: ESMCに10%を出資し、工場の生産能力の10%を使う権利
relations.text_en: Holds 10% of ESMC and is entitled to 10% of the fab capacity

source.label: NXP Semiconductors Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: NXP is entitled to 10% of the fab facility capacity.
source.note: 工場は建設中で、初期生産は2028年を目標としています。
source.note_en: The fab is under construction; initial production is targeted for 2028.

relations.text: シンガポールのSSMC工場を、合弁パートナーのTSMCとともに運営
relations.text_en: Operates the SSMC fab in Singapore together with its joint venture partner TSMC

source.label: NXP Semiconductors Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in Singapore (SSMC) together with our joint venture partner TSMC

relations.text: NXPはESMC(TSMCが70%保有)の10%を保有し、工場の生産能力の10%を受ける権利がある
relations.text_en: NXP holds 10% of ESMC (70% owned by TSMC) and is entitled to 10% of the fab capacity

source.label: NXP Semiconductors Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ESMC is 70% owned by TSMC, with 8 Bosch, Infineon, and NXP each owning 10%. NXP is entitled to 10% of the fab facility capacity.
source.note: 工場は建設中で、最初の生産は2028年を目標としています。
source.note_en: The fab is under construction; initial production is targeted for 2028.

relations.text: 1994年にTSMCが共同設立。2026年2月28日時点で約27.6%を保有
relations.text_en: Co-founded by TSMC in 1994; TSMC owned about 27.6% as of February 28, 2026

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: As of February 28, 2026 , we owned approximately 27.6 % of the equity interest in VIS.

relations.text: GlobalFoundriesが年次報告で、主な競合としてTSMC・UMC・SMICを挙げている
relations.text_en: GlobalFoundries’ annual report names TSMC, UMC and SMIC as key competitors

source.label: GlobalFoundries Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Key competitors include Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Limited ("TSMC"), United Microelectronics Corporation ("UMC") and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation.

relations.text: Towerが年次報告で、一部の分野でTSMC・UMC・SMICなどのファウンドリと競合すると記載
relations.text_en: Tower’s annual report says it competes in some areas with foundries including TSMC, UMC and SMIC

source.label: Tower Semiconductor Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete in certain areas with pure-play, advanced technology node-driven foundry service providers that also provide specialty technologies, such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation (TSMC)

relations.text: 2024年2月、TSMC・Sony・DENSO・Toyotaが第2工場に向けJASMへの追加投資を発表。Toyotaは少数株主になった
relations.text_en: In February 2024 TSMC, Sony, DENSO and Toyota announced further investment into JASM for a second fab; Toyota took a minority stake

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: announced further investment into JASM to build and operate a second semiconductor manufacturing facility. Construction on the second site commenced in October 2025. By way of such investment, Toyota 26 also took a minority stake in JASM.

relations.text: TSMCは2003年1月にGUCの52.0%を取得し、2026年2月28日時点で約34.8%を保有
relations.text_en: TSMC acquired 52.0% of GUC (SoC design service company) in January 2003 and owned approximately 34.8% as of February 28, 2026

source.label: TSMC Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: As of February 28, 2026 , we owned approximatel y 34.8 % o f the equity interest in GUC.

relations.text: Latticeは、16nmのFPGA(AvantとNexus 2)の開発・製造や、350nm〜40nm製品の製造でTSMCと提携
relations.text_en: Lattice partners with TSMC to develop and manufacture 16nm FPGAs (Avant and Nexus 2) and to manufacture 350nm, 130nm, 55nm and 40nm products

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We partner with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company ("TSMC") to develop and manufacture on 16nm technology, which is used in our Avant and Nexus 2 platforms of FPGA products

relations.text: Silicon Labsは、ウエハーの大半をTSMCとSMICを主な提携先として製造
relations.text_en: Silicon Labs partners primarily with TSMC and SMIC to manufacture the majority of its wafers

source.label: Silicon Laboratories Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We currently partner primarily with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ("TSMC") and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation ("SMIC") to manufacture the majority of our semiconductor wafers.

relations.text: NavitasはGaNウエハーの唯一の供給元としてTSMCに依存してきた。TSMCは2025年7月1日に、2027年7月にGaN生産を終了する意向を発表
relations.text_en: Navitas has historically relied on TSMC as its sole GaN wafer supplier; TSMC announced on July 1, 2025 it intends to cease GaN production in July 2027

source.label: Navitas Semiconductor Form 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: historically, we have relied on TSMC as our sole supplier of GaN wafers, a key component in our product offerings. On July 1, 2025, TSMC announced its intention to cease GaN production in July 2027.
source.note: TSMCは2027年7月にGaNの生産を終了する意向です。
source.note_en: TSMC intends to cease GaN production in July 2027.

companies.name: Himax Technologies
companies.sub: ディスプレイ用半導体

relations.text: Himaxは過去数年、TSMC・UMC・Vanguardなどからファウンドリーサービスを受けてきた
relations.text_en: Himax has obtained foundry services from TSMC, UMC, Vanguard and others in the past few years

source.label: Himax Technologies Form 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We have obtained our foundry services from TSMC, UMC, Vanguard, Macronix, Globalfoundries Singapore, PSMC, Nexchip and SKHYSI in the past few years.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
